changes: Added CL.OnItemUseStart and CL.OnItemUseEnd functions for custom client-side integrations when a player starts or stops using an item.
Added SV.CanUseItem function, allowing you to add custom conditions that determine whether a player can use an item.
Added SV.OnItemUseStart and SV.OnItemUseEnd functions for custom server-side integrations.
Added new client and server export CleanupOptionalStatuses
Added the client event vms_status:cl:reloadVisualEffect, allowing visual effects to be refreshed from the server
Added the default option to Config.Statuses, allowing default values to be configured for new players
Added the CL.InitiateFunctions, making ambulance job integrations require minimal modifications
Added Client State Bags for every status, allowing direct access to player status values and real-time change handlers
Added optional backward compatibility with esx_status:onTick, allowing most ESX HUDs to work without any code changes
Added integration guides for esx_hud, qb-hud, and qbx_hud to the documentation
